seo.title: Free Photo Food Diary for Dietitians | Caltrac AI
seo.description: Review the meals your clients choose to share, as photos with estimated calories and macros, between appointments. Free for dietitians.
seo.h1: Follow what your clients actually ate, between appointments

hero.intro: Caltrac AI for Professionals gives dietitians a view of the meals clients choose to share, with estimated calories and macros. You can start from the meals as they were logged, not from a diary rebuilt from memory the night before.

fits.heading: Where it fits in your practice

items.title: Before an appointment.
items.text: Look through the meals a client has logged, so the conversation starts from the food.

items.title: Between appointments.
items.text: Comment on a specific meal. Your client reads it in the app, next to the food.

items.title: Consent built in.
items.text: You see meals only after the client sends a request and you accept it, and they can stop at any time.

review.heading: A review between appointments
review.body: Before an appointment, open the meals a client has chosen to share and read through them. Pick the ones to talk about, and comment on a meal if you want the client to think about it before you meet. The client reads your comment in the app, next to the food.

estimates.heading: Estimates you can question
estimates.body: Clients log a meal with a photo or a short description. Caltrac AI estimates calories and macros, and clients can edit the foods and serving sizes before saving. Treat the numbers as a starting point, apply your own judgment, and decide how much weight to give them with each client.

estimatesScreenshot.alt: A meal logged from a photo in the Caltrac AI app, showing the foods found before saving

privacy.heading: Privacy and clinical use
privacy.body: Caltrac AI doesn't diagnose or treat anything and doesn't give medical advice. It doesn't replace your clinical judgment. {{hipaaClause}} See our [Terms & Conditions](/terms#not-medical-advice) and [Privacy Policy](/privacy).

items.question: Can I see a client's meals without their permission?
items.answer: No. Every link starts with the client.

items.question: Are the calories and macros exact?
items.answer: No. They're estimates, and clients can edit them.

items.question: What happens if a client stops sharing?
items.answer: Your access ends immediately. The client doesn't need approval from you or from Caltrac AI.
